description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmploymentStatusService in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of methods like delete, get by ID, save, search, and count within the EmploymentStatusService. The class uses mock objects for the DAO layer to isolate service logic.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class extending the base TestCase, testing the EmploymentStatusService methods using mocks and test data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the service instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Verifies that deleteEmploymentStatus interacts correctly with the DAO and returns the expected count.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an EmploymentStatus object by ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmploymentStatus object.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Verifies search functionality returning a list of EmploymentStatus objects.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Ensures the count of search results is correctly retrieved.
